## Flux 3 Extend API

Flux 3 Extend is a video editing model by Black Forest Labs, available on the Venice API as `flux-3-extend-video`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Flux 3 Extend continues an existing clip beyond its final frame, adding 5 to 20 seconds at up to 4K with synchronized audio.

### Flux 3 Extend API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `flux-3-extend-video` | Video edit | Anonymized | priced by source |

### Flux 3 Extend specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Black Forest Labs |
| Released | Aug 4, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Modes | video editing |
| Resolutions | 720p, 1080p, 1440p, 4K |
| Durations | 5s, 10s, 15s, 20s |
| Aspect ratios | auto, 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16, 9:21 |
| Audio | Always generated |

### How to use the Flux 3 Extend API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "flux-3-extend-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "flux-3-extend-video",
    "prompt": "Continue the drone shot as it rises above the clouds into clear sky",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "auto",
    "video_url": "https://example.com/source.mp4"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "flux-3-extend-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
